verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֥ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י כְּרֻבִ֛ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ham·miš·kān ta·‘ă·śeh ‘e·śer yə·rî·‘ōṯ šêš mā·šə·zār ū·ṯə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·la·‘aṯ šā·nî kə·ru·ḇîm ma·‘ă·śêh ḥō·šêḇ ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: You are to construct the tabernacle itself with ten curtains of finely spun linen each with blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and cherubim skillfully worked into them
verses.literalPt: E O TABERNÁCULO farás de dez cortinas de linho fino torcido, e azul, púrpura, e carmesim; com querubins as farás de obra esmerada.

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ׀ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֙חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לְכָל־ הַיְרִיעֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·reḵ hay·rî·‘āh hā·’a·ḥaṯ šə·mō·neh wə·‘eś·rîm bā·’am·māh wə·rō·ḥaḇ ’ar·ba‘ bā·’am·māh hay·rî·‘āh hā·’e·ḥāṯ mid·dāh ’a·ḥaṯ lə·ḵāl hay·rî·‘ōṯ
verses.literal: Each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits long - and four cubits wide all curtains the same size
verses.literalPt: O comprimento de uma cortina será de vinte e oito côvados, e a largura de uma cortina de quatro côvados; todas estas cortinas serão de uma medida.

verses.original: חֲמֵ֣שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֗ת תִּֽהְיֶ֙יןָ֙ חֹֽבְרֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ אֲחֹתָ֑הּ וְחָמֵ֤שׁ יְרִיעֹת֙ חֹֽבְרֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ אֲחֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·mêš hay·rî·‘ōṯ tih·ye·nā ḥō·ḇə·rōṯ ’iš·šāh ’el- ’ă·ḥō·ṯāh wə·ḥā·mêš yə·rî·‘ōṯ ḥō·ḇə·rōṯ ’iš·šāh ’el- ’ă·ḥō·ṯāh
verses.literal: Five of the curtains are to be joined together . . . . . . and the other five joined as well . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Cinco cortinas se enlaçarão uma à outra; e as outras cinco cortinas se enlaçarão uma com a outra.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָאֶחָ֔ת מִקָּצָ֖ה בַּחֹבָ֑רֶת וְכֵ֤ן תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ בִּשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה בַּמַּחְבֶּ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā lul·’ōṯ tə·ḵê·leṯ ‘al śə·p̄aṯ hay·rî·‘āh hā·’e·ḥāṯ miq·qā·ṣāh ba·ḥō·ḇā·reṯ wə·ḵên ta·‘ă·śeh biś·p̄aṯ hay·rî·‘āh haq·qî·ṣō·w·nāh bam·maḥ·be·reṯ haš·šê·nîṯ
verses.literal: Make loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set and do the same for the end curtain in the second set
verses.literalPt: E farás laçadas de azul na orla de uma cortina, na extremidade, e na juntura; assim também farás na orla da extremidade da outra cortina, na segunda juntura.

verses.original: חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת תַּעֲשֶׂה֮ בַּיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָת֒ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַיְרִיעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּמַּחְבֶּ֣רֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית מַקְבִּילֹת֙ הַלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ אֲחֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·miš·šîm lu·lā·’ōṯ ta·‘ă·śeh bay·rî·‘āh hā·’e·ḥāṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm lu·lā·’ōṯ ta·‘ă·śeh biq·ṣêh hay·rî·‘āh ’ă·šer bam·maḥ·be·reṯ haš·šê·nîṯ maq·bî·lōṯ hal·lu·lā·’ōṯ ’iš·šāh ’el- ’ă·ḥō·ṯāh
verses.literal: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set so that the loops line up opposite . . . one another
verses.literalPt: Cinqüenta laçadas farás numa cortina, e outras cinqüenta laçadas farás na extremidade da cortina que está na segunda juntura; as laçadas estarão presas uma com a outra.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים קַרְסֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וְחִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֶת־ הַיְרִיעֹ֜ת אִשָּׁ֤ה אֶל־ אֲחֹתָהּ֙ בַּקְּרָסִ֔ים וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ḥă·miš·šîm qar·sê zā·hāḇ wə·ḥib·bar·tā ’eṯ- hay·rî·‘ōṯ ’iš·šāh ’el- ’ă·ḥō·ṯāh baq·qə·rā·sîm wə·hā·yāh ham·miš·kān ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Make fifty gold clasps as well and join the curtains together . . . . . . with the clasps so that the tabernacle will be a unit
verses.literalPt: Farás também cinqüenta colchetes de ouro, e ajuntarás com estes colchetes as cortinas, uma com a outra, e será um tabernáculo.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ יְרִיעֹ֣ת עִזִּ֔ים לְאֹ֖הֶל עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַשְׁתֵּי־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה יְרִיעֹ֖ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā yə·rî·‘ōṯ ‘iz·zîm lə·’ō·hel ‘al- ham·miš·kān ‘aš·tê- ‘eś·rêh yə·rî·‘ōṯ ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: You are to make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle - eleven . . . curtains in all
verses.literalPt: Farás também cortinas de pêlos de cabras para servirem de tenda sobre o tabernáculo; onze cortinas farás.

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ׀ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֙חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְעַשְׁתֵּ֥י עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה יְרִיעֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·reḵ hay·rî·‘āh hā·’a·ḥaṯ šə·lō·šîm bā·’am·māh wə·rō·ḥaḇ ’ar·ba‘ bā·’am·māh hay·rî·‘āh hā·’e·ḥāṯ mid·dāh ’a·ḥaṯ lə·‘aš·tê ‘eś·rêh yə·rî·‘ōṯ
verses.literal: Each of the eleven . . . curtains is to be the same size thirty cubits long - and four cubits wide
verses.literalPt: O comprimento de uma cortina será de trinta côvados, e a largura da mesma cortina de quatro côvados; estas onze cortinas serão da mesma medida.

verses.original: וְחִבַּרְתָּ֞ אֶת־ חֲמֵ֤שׁ הַיְרִיעֹת֙ לְבָ֔ד וְאֶת־ שֵׁ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָ֑ד וְכָפַלְתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔ית אֶל־ מ֖וּל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥib·bar·tā ’eṯ- ḥă·mêš hay·rî·‘ōṯ lə·ḇāḏ wə·’eṯ- šêš hay·rî·‘ōṯ lə·ḇāḏ wə·ḵā·p̄al·tā ’eṯ- hay·rî·‘āh haš·šiš·šîṯ ’el- mūl pə·nê hā·’ō·hel
verses.literal: Join five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another . . . Then fold the sixth curtain over double at the front . . . of the tent
verses.literalPt: E juntarás cinco destas cortinas à parte, e as outras seis cortinas também à parte; e dobrarás a sexta cortina à frente da tenda.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת הַקִּיצֹנָ֖ה בַּחֹבָ֑רֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת עַ֚ל שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַחֹבֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ḥă·miš·šîm lu·lā·’ōṯ ‘al śə·p̄aṯ hay·rî·‘āh hā·’e·ḥāṯ haq·qî·ṣō·nāh ba·ḥō·ḇā·reṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm lu·lā·’ōṯ ‘al śə·p̄aṯ hay·rî·‘āh ha·ḥō·ḇe·reṯ haš·šê·nîṯ
verses.literal: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set
verses.literalPt: E farás cinqüenta laçadas na borda de uma cortina, na extremidade, na juntura, e outras cinqüenta laçadas na borda da outra cortina, na segunda juntura.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ קַרְסֵ֥י נְחֹ֖שֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁ֑ים וְהֵבֵאתָ֤ אֶת־ הַקְּרָסִים֙ בַּלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת וְחִבַּרְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הָאֹ֖הֶל וְהָיָ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā qar·sê nə·ḥō·šeṯ ḥă·miš·šîm wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā ’eṯ- haq·qə·rā·sîm bal·lu·lā·’ōṯ wə·ḥib·bar·tā ’eṯ- hā·’ō·hel wə·hā·yāh ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Make fifty bronze clasps and put them through the loops to join the tent together as a unit
verses.literalPt: Farás também cinqüenta colchetes de cobre, e colocarás os colchetes nas laçadas, e assim ajuntarás a tenda, para que seja uma.

verses.original: וְסֶ֙רַח֙ הָעֹדֵ֔ף בִּירִיעֹ֖ת הָאֹ֑הֶל חֲצִ֤י הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָעֹדֶ֔פֶת תִּסְרַ֕ח עַ֖ל אֲחֹרֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·se·raḥ hā·‘ō·ḏêp̄ bî·rî·‘ōṯ hā·’ō·hel ḥă·ṣî hay·rî·‘āh hā·‘ō·ḏe·p̄eṯ tis·raḥ ‘al ’ă·ḥō·rê ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: As for the overlap that remains of the tent curtains the half curtain that is left over shall hang down over the back of the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: E a parte que sobejar das cortinas da tenda, a saber, a metade da cortina que sobejar, penderá de sobra às costas do tabernáculo.

verses.original: וְהָאַמָּ֨ה מִזֶּ֜ה וְהָאַמָּ֤ה מִזֶּה֙ בָּעֹדֵ֔ף בְּאֹ֖רֶךְ יְרִיעֹ֣ת הָאֹ֑הֶל יִהְיֶ֨ה סָר֜וּחַ עַל־ צִדֵּ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן מִזֶּ֥ה וּמִזֶּ֖ה לְכַסֹּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’am·māh miz·zeh wə·hā·’am·māh miz·zeh bā·‘ō·ḏêp̄ bə·’ō·reḵ yə·rî·‘ōṯ hā·’ō·hel yih·yeh sā·rū·aḥ ‘al- ṣid·dê ham·miš·kān miz·zeh ū·miz·zeh lə·ḵas·sō·ṯōw
verses.literal: And the tent curtains will be a cubit longer on either side and the excess will hang over the sides of the tabernacle . . . . . . to cover it
verses.literalPt: E um côvado de um lado, e outro côvado do outro, que sobejará no comprimento das cortinas da tenda, penderá de sobra aos lados do tabernáculo de um e de outro lado, para cobri-lo.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ מִכְסֶה֙ לָאֹ֔הֶל עֹרֹ֥ת אֵילִ֖ם מְאָדָּמִ֑ים וּמִכְסֵ֛ה עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā miḵ·seh lā·’ō·hel ‘ō·rōṯ ’ê·lim mə·’ād·dā·mîm ū·miḵ·sêh ‘ō·rōṯ tə·ḥā·šîm mil·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: Also make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red and over that a covering . . . of fine leather
verses.literalPt: Farás também à tenda uma coberta de peles de carneiro, tintas de vermelho, e outra coberta de peles de texugo em cima.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־ הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים עֹמְדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- haq·qə·rā·šîm lam·miš·kān ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm ‘ō·mə·ḏîm
verses.literal: You are to construct upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: Farás também as tábuas para o tabernáculo de madeira de acácia, que serão postas verticalmente.

verses.original: עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ וְאַמָּה֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הָֽאַמָּ֔ה רֹ֖חַב הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ‘e·śer ’am·mō·wṯ ’ō·reḵ haq·qā·reš wə·’am·māh wa·ḥă·ṣî hā·’am·māh rō·ḥaḇ haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half . . . wide
verses.literalPt: O comprimento de uma tábua será de dez côvados, e a largura de cada tábua será de um côvado e meio.

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֣י יָד֗וֹת לַקֶּ֙רֶשׁ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד מְשֻׁלָּבֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ אֲחֹתָ֑הּ כֵּ֣ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל קַרְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: šə·tê yā·ḏō·wṯ laq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ mə·šul·lā·ḇōṯ ’iš·šāh ’el- ’ă·ḥō·ṯāh kên ta·‘ă·śeh lə·ḵōl qar·šê ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: Two tenons must be connected to each other for each frame Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way
verses.literalPt: Dois encaixes terá cada tábua, travados um com o outro; assim farás com todas as tábuas do tabernáculo.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־ הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים קֶ֔רֶשׁ לִפְאַ֖ת נֶ֥גְבָּה תֵימָֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- haq·qə·rā·šîm lam·miš·kān ‘eś·rîm qe·reš lip̄·’aṯ neḡ·bāh ṯê·mā·nāh
verses.literal: Construct - twenty frames for the south . . . side of the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: E farás as tábuas para o tabernáculo assim: vinte tábuas para o lado meridional.

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אַדְנֵי־ כֶ֔סֶף תַּעֲשֶׂ֕ה תַּ֖חַת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ שְׁנֵ֨י אֲדָנִ֜ים תַּֽחַת־ הַקֶּ֤רֶשׁ הָאֶחָד֙ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י יְדֹתָ֔יו וּשְׁנֵ֧י אֲדָנִ֛ים תַּֽחַת־ הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁתֵּ֥י יְדֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’aḏ·nê- ḵe·sep̄ ta·‘ă·śeh ta·ḥaṯ ‘eś·rîm haq·qā·reš šə·nê ’ă·ḏā·nîm ta·ḥaṯ- haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ liš·tê yə·ḏō·ṯāw ū·šə·nê ’ă·ḏā·nîm ta·ḥaṯ- haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ liš·tê yə·ḏō·ṯāw
verses.literal: with forty silver bases under the twenty frames two bases for each frame one under each tenon
verses.literalPt: Farás também quarenta bases de prata debaixo das vinte tábuas; duas bases debaixo de uma tábua para os seus dois encaixes e duas bases debaixo de outra tábua para os seus dois encaixes.

verses.original: וּלְצֶ֧לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית לִפְאַ֣ת צָפ֑וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֖ים קָֽרֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ṣe·la‘ ham·miš·kān haš·šê·nîṯ lip̄·’aṯ ṣā·p̄ō·wn ‘eś·rîm qā·reš
verses.literal: For the second side of the tabernacle the north side make twenty frames
verses.literalPt: Também haverá vinte tábuas ao outro lado do tabernáculo, para o lado norte,

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’aḏ·nê·hem kā·sep̄ šə·nê ’ă·ḏā·nîm ta·ḥaṯ haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ ū·šə·nê ’ă·ḏā·nîm ta·ḥaṯ haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: and forty silver bases two bases under each frame
verses.literalPt: Com as suas quarenta bases de prata; duas bases debaixo de uma tábua, e duas bases debaixo de outra tábua,

verses.original: וּֽלְיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָ֑מָּה תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֥ה קְרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·yar·kə·ṯê ham·miš·kān yām·māh ta·‘ă·śeh šiš·šāh qə·rā·šîm
verses.literal: Make six frames for the rear of the tabernacle the west side
verses.literalPt: E ao lado do tabernáculo para o ocidente farás seis tábuas.

verses.original: וּשְׁנֵ֤י קְרָשִׁים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לִמְקֻצְעֹ֖ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן בַּיַּרְכָתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·nê qə·rā·šîm ta·‘ă·śeh lim·quṣ·‘ōṯ ham·miš·kān bay·yar·ḵā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: Farás também duas tábuas para os cantos do tabernáculo, de ambos os lados.

verses.original: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ תֹֽאֲמִים֮ מִלְּמַטָּה֒ וְיַחְדָּ֗ו יִהְי֤וּ תַמִּים֙ עַל־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־ הַטַּבַּ֖עַת הָאֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֚ן יִהְיֶ֣ה לִשְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם לִשְׁנֵ֥י הַמִּקְצֹעֹ֖ת יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yih·yū ṯō·’ă·mîm mil·lə·maṭ·ṭāh wə·yaḥ·dāw yih·yū ṯam·mîm ‘al- rō·šōw ’el- haṭ·ṭab·ba·‘aṯ hā·’e·ḥāṯ kên yih·yeh liš·nê·hem liš·nê ham·miq·ṣō·‘ōṯ yih·yū
verses.literal: coupled together . . . . . . from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring - These will serve as the two corners
verses.literalPt: E por baixo se ajuntarão, e também em cima dele se ajuntarão numa argola. Assim se fará com as duas tábuas; ambas serão por tábuas para os dois cantos.

verses.original: וְהָיוּ֙ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה קְרָשִׁ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֲדָנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū šə·mō·nāh qə·rā·šîm wə·’aḏ·nê·hem ke·sep̄ šiš·šāh ‘ā·śār ’ă·ḏā·nîm šə·nê ’ă·ḏā·nîm ta·ḥaṯ haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ ū·šə·nê ’ă·ḏā·nîm ta·ḥaṯ haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: So there are to be eight frames and sixteen silver bases . . . . . . two under each frame
verses.literalPt: Assim serão as oito tábuas com as suas bases de prata, dezesseis bases; duas bases debaixo de uma tábua, e duas bases debaixo da outra tábua.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בְרִיחִ֖ם עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חֲמִשָּׁ֕ה לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ḇə·rî·ḥim ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm ḥă·miš·šāh lə·qar·šê ṣe·la‘- ham·miš·kān hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: You are also to make five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: Farás também cinco travessas de madeira de acácia, para as tábuas de um lado do tabernáculo,

verses.original: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֔ם לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֗ם לְקַרְשֵׁי֙ צֶ֣לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לַיַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·miš·šāh ḇə·rî·ḥim lə·qar·šê ṣe·la‘- ham·miš·kān haš·šê·nîṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šāh ḇə·rî·ḥim lə·qar·šê ṣe·la‘ ham·miš·kān lay·yar·ḵā·ṯa·yim yām·māh
verses.literal: five for those on the other side and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle to the west
verses.literalPt: E cinco travessas para as tábuas do outro lado do tabernáculo; como também cinco travessas para as tábuas do outro lado do tabernáculo, de ambos os lados, para o ocidente.

verses.original: וְהַבְּרִ֥יחַ הַתִּיכֹ֖ן בְּת֣וֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁ֑ים מַבְרִ֕חַ מִן־ הַקָּצֶ֖ה אֶל־ הַקָּצֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·bə·rî·aḥ hat·tî·ḵōn bə·ṯō·wḵ haq·qə·rā·šîm maḇ·ri·aḥ min- haq·qā·ṣeh ’el- haq·qā·ṣeh
verses.literal: The central crossbar in the middle of the frames shall extend from one end to the other . . .
verses.literalPt: E a travessa central estará no meio das tábuas, passando de uma extremidade até à outra.

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ הַקְּרָשִׁ֞ים תְּצַפֶּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְאֶת־ טַבְּעֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב בָּתִּ֖ים לַבְּרִיחִ֑ם וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֶת־ הַבְּרִיחִ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- haq·qə·rā·šîm tə·ṣap·peh zā·hāḇ wə·’eṯ- ṭab·bə·‘ō·ṯê·hem ta·‘ă·śeh zā·hāḇ bāt·tîm lab·bə·rî·ḥim wə·ṣip·pî·ṯā ’eṯ- hab·bə·rî·ḥim zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars Also overlay the crossbars with gold
verses.literalPt: E cobrirás de ouro as tábuas, e farás de ouro as suas argolas, para passar por elas as travessas; também as travessas as cobrirás de ouro.

verses.original: וַהֲקֵמֹתָ֖ אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן כְּמִ֨שְׁפָּט֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרְאֵ֖יתָ בָּהָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·qê·mō·ṯā ’eṯ- ham·miš·kān kə·miš·pā·ṭōw ’ă·šer hā·rə·’ê·ṯā bā·hār
verses.literal: So you are to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown you on the mountain
verses.literalPt: Então levantarás o tabernáculo conforme ao modelo que te foi mostrado no monte.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ פָרֹ֗כֶת תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֛ב יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖הּ כְּרֻבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā p̄ā·rō·ḵeṯ tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš mā·šə·zār ma·‘ă·śêh ḥō·šêḇ ya·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯāh kə·ru·ḇîm
verses.literal: Make a veil of blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and finely spun linen with cherubim skillfully worked into it
verses.literalPt: Depois farás um véu de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e de linho fino torcido; com querubins de obra prima se fará.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗הּ עַל־ אַרְבָּעָה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים מְצֻפִּ֣ים זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב עַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אַדְנֵי־ כָֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’ō·ṯāh ‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh ‘am·mū·ḏê šiṭ·ṭîm mə·ṣup·pîm zā·hāḇ wā·wê·hem zā·hāḇ ‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh ’aḏ·nê- ḵā·sep̄
verses.literal: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases
verses.literalPt: E colocá-lo-ás sobre quatro colunas de madeira de acácia, cobertas de ouro; seus colchetes serão de ouro, sobre quatro bases de prata.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֶת־ הַפָּרֹכֶת֮ תַּ֣חַת הַקְּרָסִים֒ וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ מִבֵּ֣ית לַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְהִבְדִּילָ֤ה הַפָּרֹ֙כֶת֙ לָכֶ֔ם בֵּ֣ין הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּבֵ֖ין קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’eṯ- hap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ ta·ḥaṯ haq·qə·rā·sîm wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā šām·māh mib·bêṯ lap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ ’êṯ ’ă·rō·wn hā·‘ê·ḏūṯ wə·hiḇ·dî·lāh hap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ lā·ḵem bên haq·qō·ḏeš ū·ḇên qō·ḏeš haq·qo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: And hang the veil from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the veil So the veil will separate the Holy Place . . . from the Most Holy Place . . .
verses.literalPt: Pendurarás o véu debaixo dos colchetes, e porás a arca do testemunho ali dentro do véu; e este véu vos fará separação entre o santuário e o lugar santíssimo,

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת בְּקֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯa·tā ’eṯ- hak·kap·pō·reṯ ‘al ’ă·rō·wn hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ bə·qō·ḏeš haq·qo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: Put the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place . . .
verses.literalPt: E porás a coberta do propiciatório sobre a arca do testemunho no lugar santíssimo,

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ מִח֣וּץ לַפָּרֹ֔כֶת וְאֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָה֙ נֹ֣כַח הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן עַ֛ל צֶ֥לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָ֑נָה וְהַ֨שֻּׁלְחָ֔ן תִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־ צֶ֥לַע צָפֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tā ’eṯ- haš·šul·ḥān mi·ḥūṣ lap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ wə·’eṯ- ham·mə·nō·rāh nō·ḵaḥ haš·šul·ḥān ‘al ṣe·la‘ ham·miš·kān tê·mā·nāh wə·haš·šul·ḥān tit·tên ‘al- ṣe·la‘ ṣā·p̄ō·wn
verses.literal: And place the table outside the veil on the north side of the tabernacle and put the lampstand opposite the table on the south side
verses.literalPt: E a mesa porás fora do véu, e o candelabro defronte da mesa, ao lado do tabernáculo, para o sul; mas a mesa porás ao lado do norte.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ מָסָךְ֙ לְפֶ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā mā·sāḵ lə·p̄e·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš mā·šə·zār ma·‘ă·śêh rō·qêm
verses.literal: For the entrance to the tent you are to make a curtain embroidered with blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and finely spun . . . linen
verses.literalPt: Farás também para a porta da tenda, uma cortina de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e de linho fino torcido, de obra de bordador.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לַמָּסָ֗ךְ חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתָם֙ זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְיָצַקְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אַדְנֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā lam·mā·sāḵ ḥă·miš·šāh ‘am·mū·ḏê šiṭ·ṭîm wə·ṣip·pî·ṯā ’ō·ṯām zā·hāḇ wā·wê·hem zā·hāḇ wə·yā·ṣaq·tā lā·hem ḥă·miš·šāh ’aḏ·nê nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: Make five posts of acacia wood for the curtain overlay them with gold use hooks of gold and cast five bronze bases for them
verses.literalPt: E farás para esta cortina cinco colunas de madeira de acácia, e as cobrirás de ouro; seus colchetes serão de ouro, e far-lhe-ás de fundição cinco bases de cobre.
